description.value:
Cast 1 hour

Requirement You have a captured soul or spirit fragment in your Static Cell.

Duration permanent

Permanently strengthen your Rig by binding a captured soul into it — escalating power, escalating attention from things that notice bound souls.

Bind the soul into your Rig. Your Rig permanently gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and to its class DC, and 5 additional Hit Points per level. You may take this feat's binding again each time you capture another soul; each binding after the first adds the same benefit and raises the Attention on you by one step. At Attention 1 the bound things notice; at 2 they follow; at 3 something comes for the Rig. The GM decides what, and when.

cinderfall.incomplete: [RIG-GENERIC-AMBIGUOUS] + [RIG-NO-ACTOR] -- this card isn't tagged to a specific ghostRigTier, so it's meant to apply to whichever of the three Rig choices a character took. For Ghost-Rig it needs a companion actor's own attack/DC/HP (doesn't exist). For Iron Lung/Widowmaker it could theoretically graft onto the PC's own proficiency stats, but there is no existing mechanism in this corpus tying a single generic card to three different stat targets by hidden subclass choice. The "Attention" escalation is GM narrative on top, itself unbuildable (no numeric threshold-tracking rule element for a homebrew meta-counter). See Open Questions #1 in .claude/scratch/feats-class-scrapwright-draft.md.
